theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (B : Set (Euclid P)) (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), IsOpen B → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ B → μ₁ K < ∞) → μ₁.restrict B = μ₂.restrict B → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ₁ μ₁ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ₂ μ₂ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ₁, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ₁ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ₂, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ₂ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ (E : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : TestFormOn B k), MeasurableSet E → ∫ x in E, ξ₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₁ = ∫ x in E, ξ₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₂) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ₁, x ∈ B → ξ₁ x = ξ₂ x
